rule: A supported public workflow is incomplete until an assembled first-use test starts from the minimum documented external state and reaches the workflow through the real public entrypoint without pre-creating internal state owned by that workflow.

scenarios.minimum_state: real Git repository with a commit and no .ci/repoworkflow.json
Git checkout with discoverable provider remote and no RWF workflow configuration
prohibited_shortcuts: configured infoCommand for the assembled-path case

scope: native ticket dependencies -> canonical RWF graph -> rwf lanes select -> rwf lanes list
scenarios.minimum_state: normal Git checkout/provider access with no relationship graph or lane-selection records
prohibited_shortcuts: mocking dependency stores in the assembled test

scope: ordinary human/session invocation of mutating public commands
scenarios.minimum_state: supported CLI/shell session without manually exported internal runtime identity
prohibited_shortcuts: manual RWF_WRITER_ID/RWF_SESSION_ID in the human first-use scenario

scope: expected missing/precondition states through public commands
scenarios.minimum_state: registered first-use scenarios at each immediate missing-state boundary

scope: issue start / workspace creation / claim/resume lifecycle
scenarios.minimum_state: documented adopted repository/session state with provider facts but no fabricated relationship/current-work/lifecycle/workspace records

scope: what-next and currently supported validation transitions
scenarios.minimum_state: documented adopted repository state reached through public issue/work setup

scope: consumer adoption -> local pinned launcher -> hosted handoff
prohibited_shortcuts: testing only launcher Python function with mocked subprocess

exempt_prefixes.version: Temporary compatibility/internal surface; PUBLIC_WORKFLOW.md explicitly says normal public surface does not include rwf version.
